title: Unwanted loop run when switching targets.
symptom: When switching from one temporary target to another without cancelling first, AAPS performs two separate events (cancel TT and start new TT), each triggering a loop run. In between, the loop may deliver an unwanted SMB because the high temporary target is no longer active, leading to potential overreaction and rollercoaster effect.
cause: The target switch is not atomic; the loop is triggered by database changes, and there are two changes: ending the current TT and starting the new TT.
fix: The issue was addressed by a commit (2feaa419a715000eff001e5d58ca12e073cca8f1) that likely makes the target switch atomic, preventing intermediate loop runs. However, the exact fix details are not described in the thread.
evidence_quote: well is not atomic. loop is triggered by database change and there are 2 changes: end current TT and start new TT.
